statement: ∀ C : Set (V n), IsCompact C → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ C ⊆ innerBox n R
proof:
intro C hC
obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (continuous_id.continuousOn : ContinuousOn (fun x : V n => x) C)
let R : ℝ := max L 0 + 1
have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; have := le_max_right L 0; linarith
refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
intro x hx j
have hcoord : ‖x j‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_le_pi_norm x j
have hLR : L < R := by dsimp [R]; have := le_max_left L 0; linarith
have habs : |x j| < R := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hcoord.trans_lt ((hL x hx).trans_lt hLR)
exact abs_lt.mp habs
